rust_summary: Open a native mod's modal screen over ordinary title menus or the world, preserving the underlying title and its input isolation.
doc_summary:
### @API:mod_screen_open_anywhere@ `mod_screen_open_anywhere`

`fn native_mod_screen_open_anywhere(&mut self, mod_id: &str) -> bool` opens the mod-owned modal screen over ordinary title menus as well as in a world. The world path retains `native_mod_screen_open` behavior. A title modal uses the existing screen render, key, character, mouse and IME hooks; underlying title widgets receive no input. An uncanceled Escape restores the previous title menu without grabbing the mouse. Loading, recovery, onboarding, warning and security-confirmation screens reject opening. Reopening the same owner's screen succeeds; another owner cannot replace it. No open modal means title rendering and input continue through their existing paths.
